capture.source: broker_observed (seoseo broker state, readonly; live broker_tasks + tombstones, deduped by task id)
capture.groupRule: in-memory repetition grouping (never emitted); identical_work >=3 occurrences, retry ==2, unique ==1
capture.privacy: banded fields only; message text and any digests of it never left the broker host
